prompt: I'm designing a new 8-item survey to measure 'product trust.' Each item is a 7-point Likert. We have ~600 participants in a pilot. What analyses would you recommend, and what mistakes should I avoid?
assertions: Recommends parallel analysis (e.g., psych::fa.parallel) for determining number of factors
Recommends polychoric correlations for the Likert data (e.g., cor='poly' or psych::polychoric)
Recommends oblique rotation (oblimin, promax) rather than orthogonal/varimax
Recommends omega (in addition to or instead of alpha) for reliability
Mentions splitting the sample or using an independent sample for CFA after EFA
Warns against eigenvalue > 1 rule for selecting number of factors
Mentions cognitive interviews, pilot/pretesting, or content review as a step
Includes at least one R code example with psych or lavaan
Mentions that 600 N is adequate for EFA and CFA with this scale size
